trimmedBy: node trim-ats-a-captures.mjs (JSON.parse, whole-record selection by job id (meta.total rewritten to the kept count so the envelope stays self-consistent), regex redaction of e-mail addresses and separator-bearing phone numbers inside string values, JSON.stringify, prettier); never a byte cut
notes: 453 jobs captured, 2 kept: 7421718 carries a body that its author escaped TWICE (the visible text "< 60% travel" arrives as "&lt; 60% travel"), and 8288769 has location.name "Hybrid" (a workplace type in the location field). Whole response 8.0 MB, 28,539 JSON nodes. OWNERSHIP VERIFIED, EVIDENCE: PAYLOAD_FIELD (the per-job company_name): it is "Cloudflare" on 453 of 453 jobs; absolute_url is boards.greenhouse.io/cloudflare/jobs/N?gh_jid=N. Documented (https://docs.greenhouse.io/job-board.html): GET endpoints need no authentication ("Job Board data is publicly available"); only the application POST needs Basic auth. robots.txt of boards-api.greenhouse.io: User-agent * / Disallow: /embed/ only, so /v1/boards/{token}/jobs is allowed. The docs state no rate limit or terms of use. Job content is HTML-escaped by Greenhouse (entities) and the adapter decodes it once. company_name and first_published appear on every job of this response although the docs show them only in the single-job example. E-mail addresses and phone numbers inside string values were replaced by a parser; personal NAMES in free-text descriptions cannot be found by a parser and were not redacted (records were chosen with short descriptions to limit exposure).
